column1: # The alert table (section 6.7 of the state-machine plan): the twelve alerts, the rules that keep one cause from raising many, the ladder and the limits by kind.

# One reader: bin/jg-alert.sh (row, rules, limit, raise). Every time counts from the moment the state began. Seconds are plain numbers; "beats:N" is N missed beats of the watcher (its grace is the watcher's, not set here).

# alert:  name, fires on, fires at (seconds, beats:N or "limit" = the limit of its kind), precedence, first rung (0 tick, 1 worker, 2 lead, 3 Main, 4 owner; "wait" = the one the wait names), quiet when (facts joined by +; "never")

# rule:   id, covering alert ("*" = any alert of the same ticket with a higher precedence), scope the cover and the covered share, alerts kept quiet, why. I6 (presence) holds rung 4 and is applied by the ladder.
# ladder: precedence, seconds to the next rung, seconds between repeats, top rung ("start+2" = two rungs above the first, at most 3), the fact that lifts the top to 4 ("-" = none)
# capacity and supervision-down start at rung 1, not 0, so their producers keep their live wakes; the tick-driven climb that would let them start at rung 0 is a later slice.
# limit:  kind of work, seconds (0 = none), why
